name: vael-paper-write
title_zh: 每晚自动排版的个人日报，明早醒来就有新一版
tagline_zh: 睡前丢进素材，醒来拿到排版好的个人报纸。不是摘要合集，是带栏目、分版块的成品，专治「收藏了但从不回看」的碎片信息。
tagline_en: Drop in raw notes at night, wake to a laid-out personal paper. Not a digest—a real edition with sections, for.
desc_en: Write tomorrow's edition of the personal newspaper. Use when asked to produce, draft, assemble or fix an edition, section, or story for the Vael Paper — the nightly generator loop.
why_zh: 它把「整理信息」变成「编辑报纸」：有版面逻辑、有明日视角，逼你每晚做一次策展式取舍，而不是机械归档。
why_en: It reframes organizing as editing—each night you curate for tomorrow's reader (you), not just file things away.
limit_zh: 只认 Vael Paper 的目录结构和模板约定；不接通用 Markdown 或 RSS 源。产物是报纸版式草稿。
limit_en: Only works with Vael Paper's directory & template conventions; no generic Markdown/RSS. Outputs a draft edition—no images, print, or push.
title_en: Your nightly personal newspaper, auto-set for tomorrow
